# Water contact sounds

Source: [40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX](https://opengameart.org/content/40-cc0-water-splash-slime-sfx) by **rubberduck**, published 29 July 2018.

License: [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

- `swim.mp3`: `splash_09.ogg`
- `entry.mp3`: `splash_02.ogg`
- `plunge.mp3`: `splash_01.ogg`

Converted to mono MP3 at 64 kbps, loudness normalized; source recordings otherwise unchanged.
